about.heading: Anaclet's Experts Legal & Financial Consultancy Ltd
about.lede: AELFC Ltd is a professional consulting firm based in Kigali, Rwanda, delivering comprehensive legal, financial and business solutions to individuals, businesses, NGOs and public institutions.
paragraphs: We combine legal expertise, financial excellence and strategic advisory services to help our clients achieve compliance, improve performance, manage risks and attain sustainable growth. Every client deserves reliable, practical and innovative solutions tailored to their unique needs, delivered by a multidisciplinary team committed to professionalism, integrity and confidentiality.

Our core areas of expertise include Legal Advisory, Accounting & Bookkeeping, Tax Consultancy, Internal & External Audit, Financial Advisory, Business & Management Consultancy, Mediation & Alternative Dispute Resolution (ADR), Research & Training, and Capacity Building. We work closely with our clients to strengthen governance, improve financial management, resolve disputes amicably and support informed decision-making.
about.vision: To become a leading legal, financial and business consultancy firm in Africa, recognized for excellence, innovation, integrity and transformative professional services.
about.mission: To provide high-quality legal, financial, mediation and business advisory services that empower individuals and organizations to make informed decisions, achieve compliance, resolve disputes effectively and realize sustainable growth.
about.mottoSub: Live by choice, not by chance.

founder.name: Anaclet Mugisha
founder.role: Founder & Managing Director | Legal, Financial & Business Consultant
founder.imageAlt: Anaclet Mugisha, Founder of AELFC Ltd
paragraphs: Anaclet Mugisha is the Founder and Managing Director of AELFC Ltd, a multidisciplinary consultancy firm providing professional legal, financial, business and mediation services in Rwanda. He is a dedicated legal and financial professional with expertise in corporate governance, accounting, auditing, taxation, financial management, compliance and alternative dispute resolution.

He holds a Bachelor of Science in Accounting from the University of Rwanda and is a Certified Public Finance Manager (CPFM) and a Bachelor of Laws (LL.B.). He is also pursuing a Master of Business Administration (MBA) in Finance at the University of Lay Adventists of Kigali (UNILAK), while advancing toward the Certified Public Accountant (CPA) qualification at the Intermediate Level.

Throughout his career, Anaclet has served in key positions including Chief Accountant, Internal Auditor, Financial Consultant and Accounting Professional, supporting government institutions, private companies and non-governmental organizations. He also leads professional training and capacity-building initiatives in accounting, finance, taxation, auditing, legal practice, entrepreneurship and business management.
founder.quote: I believe that sound legal guidance, strong financial management, and ethical leadership are the foundation of sustainable organizations. My mission is to help clients make informed decisions, manage risks effectively, and achieve long-term success.

sections.body: Anaclet's Experts Legal & Financial Consultancy Ltd (AELFC Ltd) respects your privacy. This policy explains what information we collect through this website and how we use it.

sections.heading: Information We Collect
sections.body: When you use our contact form, booking form, or reach out via WhatsApp or email, we collect the information you provide directly — such as your name, email address, phone number, profession, and details about the service you are requesting.

sections.heading: How We Use Your Information
sections.body: We use this information only to respond to your inquiry, schedule and deliver the service you requested, and communicate with you about that engagement. We do not sell or rent your personal information to third parties.

sections.heading: How We Store Your Information
sections.body: Form submissions on this site are sent to our email inbox via Formspree. We do not operate a separate database of website visitor submissions.

sections.heading: Confidentiality
sections.body: As a legal and financial consultancy, we treat all client information with strict confidentiality, consistent with our professional obligations.

sections.heading: Contact Us
sections.body: If you have questions about this policy or how your information is handled, contact us using the details on our contact page.
This policy covers paid coaching and advisory sessions booked through this website.

sections.heading: Booking & Payment
sections.body: Sessions are confirmed once payment has been made and a slot has been agreed with our team. Payment secures your booking time.

sections.heading: Cancellations & Rescheduling
sections.body: If you need to reschedule, contact us at least 24 hours before your scheduled session and we will work with you to find a new time at no extra cost.

sections.heading: Refunds
sections.body: Because sessions involve dedicated preparation and reserved time, fees are generally non-refundable once a session has taken place. If you cancel with less than 24 hours' notice or do not attend, the session fee is forfeited. If AELFC Ltd is unable to deliver a session you have paid for, you will receive a full refund or a rescheduled session, at your choice.

sections.heading: Questions
sections.body: For any question about a specific booking, contact us using the details on our contact page before making payment.
